properties.decision: Anthony's choice, 2026-10-27: "Keep the floor". The counts are the answer. A budget_chars below loop_status's floor (every count, one row per list, every long text cut: about 5.4k characters on reflow2's own design) is answered at the floor, over the budget, and the budget note says so and why: "AND THE REPLY IS STILL N CHARACTERS with every list at one row and every long text cut: what remains is the report's own counts and structure, which this budget cannot hold — raise `budget_chars`." Lists are not emptied and counts are not dropped to meet it.
